notes.title: Rock Digger 0.7.2: Brand New World (part 2)
notes.content:
The second part of the major Brand New Worlds update is finally here!

Major features :


First Challenge Room

The room on the other side of the first portal is now complete!
If you can complete the challenge, you will be able to forge the silver pickaxe and gain the ability to reach deeper biomes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136939/c30480b8487655c870804a763de26ac4ec646e60.gif

Fast Travel and New Map UI

The map now display controls to pan, zoom, teleport, ...
You can also buy a new power to gain the ability to fast travel to any previous shops!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136939/dd27a0feb536ba30b9475f8909a7404ef249a73d.png

New Dangers

New ways to die! You can now encounter lava pillars and falling rocks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136939/347be23f5d4fcebc2b34f43d88b5c183737fc9e6.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136939/613c2a4379ebc96eed1b39edec99febca4917f15.gif

New Player Animations

The player character is now animated when walking while holding a pickaxe or vacuuming, and walks a bit slower while doing so.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136939/9c735a2d498e860299eb0f1870012e303f38cf51.gif

Better Tutorials and Hints

The game now detects your current control scheme and display relevant control hints and tutorials. The button icons have also been redrawn for better clarity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136939/74c4e71ad6dfefc48987d137fd7d8256734f7e54.png



Features :


Player Art: The player character's outline has been reworked and now looks better.

Inventory: The UI now display the percentage of used inventory space, in addition to the current TPs.



Bugfixes :


Fixed an issue where some tutorials would show again after each reload.
Fixed an issue where the vacuum animation would play incorrectly in some cases.
Fixed an issue where the charged shot would either get "stuck" charging or would not throw a pickaxe at all.

notes.title: Rock Digger 0.7.0: Brand New World (part 1)
notes.content:
A major update for the Rock Digger demo has just been published!

Major features :


Full overhaul of the world's structure

Rather than each biome being a completely separate level, the world is now one huge area with different biomes appearing depending on your current depth. Progress should flow a lot better, and the world now looks more natural!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136939/e55a70c5c62133daa8c4be340e6aa752ad1054e0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136939/fdd3645bbc0183a4ea7289e4ecc36b275b51a5ac.png

Shops reworks

Alchemy circles (shops) can now be found underground regularly, making backtracking significantly less frequent. If your inventory is full, it's now most often faster to simply carry on rather than going back to a previous shop.

New Pickaxes

The starting copper pickaxe  can now only dig "low level" blocks. To progress deeper, the player will need to create new, stronger pickaxes. 
There is currently 4 different pickaxes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136939/7f5c942d585412714cb452ec9e43cead4693aa32.png

Portals (experimental)

Mysterious portals can now be found near the bottom of each biomes. Entering will be required to acquire the necessary materials for creating new pickaxes!
(Note: the portals' other side isn't ready yet, so for now just finding the portal will complete the objective)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136939/21181cacf5852da3392c8fdf0276c46d506efbda.png

New Biome (experimental)

The 4th biome can now be entered, and a new ore can be found inside.
For now, this biome is lacking unique special rooms, so this is more of a preview.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136939/c1b9a7ee5cfbabf31a03a236e6b67988ee44dd02.png



Features :


Map Screen Rework: When opening the full-screen map, the entire world can now be viewed (you still need to remove the fog of war by exploring first), rather than being limited to a short distance. This is also useful to take advantage of a new upgrade.

New Upgrade: A new map-related upgrade can be found in the first biome. Go check out what it does! :)

New art and animations to display the different pickaxes.

The player can now detect nearby portal on the map, and check if all portals has been found in the current biome (PS. Same thing was already possible for new upgrades and special rooms)

Upgrades to the player's ore carrying capacity are now unlocked earlier, meaning more powerful upgrades can be acquired at a lower depth.



Bugfixes :


Made pickaxe throwing more responsive and fixed a bug where it would get "stuck" charging a mega pickaxe.
Fixed an issue where tutorials could sometimes appear behind terrain.

notes.title: Rock Digger 0.6.4 Demo Update
notes.content:
New update for the demo!

Features : 

 New UI for notifying the player when the inventory is being upgraded, or when it's full.
 New tutorial for puzzle rooms requiring the vacuum.
 New upgrade (detect range).
 New particle system for block splatters.

notes.title: Rock Digger 0.6.2 Demo Update
notes.content:
New update for the demo!

Features : 

 The third biome is now complete, along with over a dozen new special rooms!
 New danger : Lava
 New upgrade : Portals


Bugfixes : 

 Made the pickaxe throw more accurate relative to the crosshair
 Fixed timing of death animation
 Fixed some tutorials disappearing too fast

notes.title: Rock Digger 0.6.1 Demo Update
notes.content:
I released a small update for the demo.

Features : 

 Ores now make sounds when colliding.
 You can now see your stats in the shop, and how they would change if you buy an upgrade.
 Visual redesign for the shop screen.
 New sound when charging a mega pickaxe.


Bugfixes : 

 Fixed a bug where some hints on how to progress weren't appearing.
 Fixed a bug where the shop would show descriptions for non unlocked abilities.
 Fixed an input lag issue when trying to spam pickaxes.
